programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Strasbourg - 2nd round singles match: Marie Bouzková - Oleksandra Olijnykova
programme.desc: Marie Bouzková started her competition in France with a victory over Katerina Siniaková (7:6, 6:3). Now the Czech will face Oleksandra Olyjnykova. The Ukrainian made a surprise in the previous round by knocking Alexandra Eala out of the tournament (3:6, 7:5, 6:3)

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Strasbourg - 2nd round singles match: Clara Tauson - Jaqueline Cristian
programme.desc: Both women last met on the court in 2024 during the competition in Cluj-Napoca. At that time, Jequeline Cristian was on top, defeating Clara Tauson 6:4, 6:0. In Strasbourg, the Romanian wants to repeat this result and thus reach the quarterfinals

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Strasbourg - 2nd round singles match: Zhang Shuai - Diane Parry
programme.desc: After being eliminated from the 1000 in Rome, Diane Parry decided to come to her homeland. The Frenchwoman first appeared in the Challenger in Paris, where she won all the matches. She managed to extend her series of victories in the capital in the first round in Strasbourg, in which she defeated Emma Raducanu (6:4, 7:6). We will see if he will be able to maintain his streak against Zhang Shuai. The Chinese woman approaches this match encouraged by her triumph against Cristina Bucsa (2:6, 7:6, 7:5)

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Strasbourg - 2nd round singles match: Emma Navarro - Iva Jovic
programme.desc: Emma Navarro started her competition in France with a victory over Sara Bejlek (6:1, 6:4). Now the American will face Iva Jovic. Her compatriot came to Strasbourg after a good performance in Rome. In Italy, she reached the fourth round, where she was defeated by Coco Gauff

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Strasbourg - singles quarterfinal match: Marie Bouzková - Ann Li
programme.desc: Ann Li sensationally defeated Ekaterina Aleksandrova in the previous round (4:6, 6:4, 6:3). Now the American will face Maria Bouzkova. The Czech comes to this fight after a match lasting only 4 games with Oleksandra Olyjnykova, who had to withdraw due to an injury.

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Strasbourg - singles quarterfinal match: Jaqueline Cristian - Daria Kasatkina
programme.desc: Both women last met on the court during the January competition in Adelaide. At that time, Jaqueline Cristian was on top, defeating Daria Kasatkina 6:4, 6:0. In Strasbourg, the Romanian wants to repeat this result and thus reach the semi-finals

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Strasbourg - singles quarterfinal match: Zhang Shuai - Emma Navarro
programme.desc: Emma Navarro came to life in Strasbourg. After a confident victory over Sara Bejlek (6:1, 6:4), the American defeated the higher ranked Iva Jovic (6:4, 4:6, 6:1). He will try to maintain his good streak in the competition with Zhang Shuai, with whom he has a score to settle. During the February competition in Merida, she lost to the Chinese 4:6, 4:6 in the quarterfinal match.

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Strasbourg - singles quarterfinal match: Victoria Mboko - Leylah Fernandez
programme.desc: The last time the two women met on the court was in 2025 during the competition in Hong Kong. At that time, Victoria Mboko was on top, defeating Leylah Fernandez 2:6, 6:3, 6:2. In Strasbourg, the Canadian wants to repeat this result and thus reach the semi-finals

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Strasbourg - singles semi-final match: Emma Navarro - Ann Li
programme.desc: Both women last met on the court in 2019 in Charleston. At that time, Emma Navarro was on top, defeating Ann Li 6:3, 6:4. In Strasbourg, the American wants to repeat this result and thus reach the final of the last tournament before the French Open

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill – Capturing the Legend | S01E02
programme.desc: Naturalist and film producer Dan O'Neill travels across Asia in search of extremely rare snow leopards. Its goal is to create a new research center for these predatory cats, also known as snow leopards. Dan's team investigates Dude's territory. According to researchers, females may play a much greater role than previously assumed. The host of the show comes across an unusual group of snow leopards. Great Britain. 2025. film przyrodniczy

programme.title: Lion Rules – Hide and Seek | E03
programme.desc: In the floodplains of the lower reaches of the African Kuando River, called Chobe, a pride of lions dominates the local ecosystem. The clan, consisting of a dozen or so individuals, is ruled by two brothers and a brave female. The rebellious young lion Einstein stands out from them. Even though he should leave the family herd, he stubbornly sticks to his loved ones. With the arrival of the dry season, lions start fighting for survival. They try to protect their territory and offspring from rivals. When the cubs appear, Einstein decides to leave for good and start a new life. During the rainy season, the vegetation turns green rapidly, making it difficult for the lions to camouflage. Einstein tries to make new bonds, but he finds it very difficult. Mad-Eye Moody kidnaps Keeza and her pup. South Africa. 2025. nature series

programme.title: Wild Cuba: A trip to the Caribbean | E01
programme.desc: Colin Stafford Johnson prowadzi widzów w czasy sprzed zaledwie 50 lat, kiedy ziemska przyroda wydawała się obfita. It is a journey into a world that may soon disappear forever. Wyprawa rozpoczyna się na południu wyspy na Bagnie Zapata. The largest single protected area in the entire Caribbean is home to the world's smallest bird, the bee hummingbird. Decades of a conservation-minded socialist government, US embargoes and minimal development have left the region largely unchanged for five decades. Niezależnie od polityki, izolacja Kuby stworzyła naturalną cytadelę na Karaibach. Forests cover large areas of the island, and its waters contain some of the richest coral reefs in the world. Half of Cuba's flora and fauna are found only here - from the local species of crocodiles and snakes to the smallest birds and frogs on the planet. Colin Stafford Johnson begins his expedition in the swamps of the Zapata Peninsula. Cuba's isolation means that there are places that have remained unchanged for decades, and the coral reef is one of the richest in the world. Austria. 2020. documentary film

programme.title: Afryka: życie na gorąco – Sucha sawanna | E01
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. Lions' prey tend to feed when the hunters are resting - the hottest time of the day. The increase in temperature affects the behavior of animals living in these hot areas. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Hidden gems of Scandinavia
programme.desc: The authors visit four regions of the peninsula in northern Europe. programme.title: Earth – the planet of life – The rise and fall of dinosaurs | E04
programme.desc: Earth has survived countless collisions and disasters in the solar system. From asteroid impacts to volcanic eruptions and climate crises. Program przedstawi, jak wyglądała część z nich. Dinosaurs were the dominant form of life on our planet for over 150 million years. However, they disappeared along with most species in a mass extinction event around 66 million years ago. Germany. 2023. documentary series

Canito is the son of Barcelona in the seventies, of the street, of the neighborhood, of marginality. He flirted with crime, but football rescued him, for a time. He played, among other teams, for Cádiz, Español, his great love, Barcelona, ​​Betis, Zaragoza and was international on one occasion. programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Andoni Zubizarreta» Andoni Zubizarreta developed his professional career at Deportivo Alavés, Athletic Club, FCBarcelona and Valencia. Representative of the great school of Basque goalkeepers, he is the footballer with the most games played in the history of the First Division. He played 622 games and all of them as a starter between 1981 and 1988. He was part of the golden era of Johan Cruyff's so-called Dream Team, winning the first European Cup in the history of the Catalan club. In 1994 and with his sixth league championship title, he left the Barcelona team to play for Valencia CF. Natural, sober, respectful and professional leader, Andoni Zubizarreta has been one of the best goalkeepers in the Spanish championship and is also still first in the classification of minutes played

programme.title: 30 for 30: Long Gone Summer
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Pardon the Interruption
programme.desc: Pardon the Interruption (Sports). The debate is the story in this fast-paced, half-hour series hosted by former Washington Post sportswriters Tony Kornheiser and Michael Wilbon. The pair engage in high-energy discussions, conduct interviews and often argue over topics not even related to sports. Other sports reporters appear as guests and offer opinions on the top stories of the day

programme.title: The Biggest Game
programme.desc: The Biggest Game (News). Join Jeremy Schaap, one of ESPN's most respected and longest-tenured personalities, as he explores the evolution of America's biggest game, the Super Bowl. In this show, Schaap will interview the people who have made it happen. From the heroes and villains on the field, to the stars and celebrities of halftime shows, and the people involved in the stories that surround the game. This narrative video podcast breaks down how it all came to be as we approach Super Bowl LXI

programme.title: The Last Dance: Episode 9
programme.desc: The Last Dance (Sports). In the fall of 1997, Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls allowed a film crew to follow them as they went for their sixth NBA title in eight seasons. That resulted in a stunning portrait of one of the sport's most iconic athletes and a celebrated team. «The Last Dance» follows the Bulls' 1997-98 season from start to finish, while also covering the rest of the chapters in Jordan's remarkable career. The 10-part docuseries follows the Jordan timeline from when he was an emerging star on his high school team to becoming a worldwide marketing force and cultural figure. The series takes its name from a phrase coined by then-Bulls coach Phil Jackson, who knew that the season would likely be the final run for the core members of that 1990s Bulls dynasty

programme.title: In the animal world. 27 p.
programme.desc: The fauna of our planet is vibrant and diverse, since the climatic conditions in different parts of it differ. An educational and exciting documentary project with fragments of the legendary show by Nikolai Drozdov. Great Britain, 2018, educational

programme.title: d/f Revival of Savannah

programme.title: d/s Love in the wild. 2 s.

programme.title: d/s Arsenal of animals. Tooth and claw

programme.title: d/s Life in the glow. Shine to connect

These bright hues are not a decorative effect, but an important tool for survival, hunting, protection and communication between individuals. Each glow carries meaning, helping you find food, avoid danger and build relationships in the complex ecosystem of the wild. 2025

programme.title: d/f Mavindo. The Great Drama of the Serengeti

Dir.: Juan Luis Santos. Spain, 2019

programme.title: d/s Survival strategy. Secret War: Courtship Period

programme.title: d/s Strange creatures of the oceans. When night falls

Spain, 2024

programme.title: d/f Kings of the Sky

programme.title: d/s Inventions of nature. Life without water

programme.desc: The question is an age-old one: Did the chicken or the egg come first? And just one of the mysteries about the lime shell that David Attenborough wants to decipher. The legendary nature filmmaker backlights the biological processes and procedures that make up the egg. Questions are answered such as: Why do some birds only lay one egg, others several? Why do birds lay eggs? \n\nImportant factors that can influence the miracle egg are nest building, food supply, breeding location, brood care and many more. A lot happens until a chick is ready to hatch out of its protective shell...

programme.title: Wild Peru: Surviving in the Andes
programme.desc: The “Madre de Dios” region extends in the southeast of Peru.

programme.title: The African savannah – a unique habitat
programme.desc: Being born in Africa comes with major obstacles. Predators are waiting to prey on the little ones. And not every young animal receives protection from a family group. (Station info).

programme.title: The African savannah – a unique habitat
programme.desc: Is the lion the true ruler of animals? Herbivores and birds are underestimated in the savannah. Although they fight for survival with enormous endurance. (Station info).

programme.title: Portugal – wild and untamed
programme.desc: The mountains of northern Portugal are the last refuge of the Iberian wolf. Not far away, Bonelli's eagles and Egyptian vultures soar over the gorge of the Douro River in search of prey. (Station info).

programme.title: The Alps
programme.desc: Hardly any region is as diverse as the Alps. The mountains stretch across eight countries at an altitude of over 4,000 meters from the Ligurian Sea to the Pannonian Basin. Brown bears were considered extinct in most of the high mountains. There is now a small population of around 100 animals again. Lynx and Alpine ibex also returned. Marmots eat bacon on the alpine pastures. Your big enemy: the golden eagle. \n\nThe film team shot for over four years.

programme.title: The Alps
programme.desc: The Alps stretch across eight countries in Central Europe, store huge amounts of water and are home to diverse flora and fauna. This episode of the Alpine documentary is dedicated to the cold season.\n\nIn winter, animals like the golden eagle in the Alps have to contend with icy temperatures, meters of snow including avalanches and many other dangers. But they developed different strategies to survive in the bitter cold and to defy the daily challenges.

programme.title: Wild Heroes: The Auckland Zoo Heroes
programme.desc: Orangutan Daya moves out of temporary quarantine into her home in the zoo's primate enclosure. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild animals' struggle for survival
programme.desc: Bush elephants can survive in the Namibia desert with extremely little water. Max Djenohan observes how the pachyderm has certainly developed strategies to survive. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild animals' struggle for survival
programme.desc: Max Djenohan is fascinated by the saltwater crocodile that lives in the mangrove forests of Borneo. The reptile has learned how to regulate its temperature and best capture prey. (Station info).

programme.title: SWEET STRANGER AND ME

programme.title: OUR HAPPY DAYS
programme.desc: Một câu chuyện gia đình hỗn loạn, đầy rủi ro, trong đó một người đàn ông có vẻ hoàn hảo và một người phụ nữ có nhiều khuyết điểm đáng yêu va chạm nhau trong khi mọi thế hệ đều đấu tranh để trở thành nhân vật chính của cuộc đời họ.

programme.title: A GRACEFUL LIAR

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: ĐẶC VỤ TỬ THẦN - AGENT OF DEATH
programme.desc: Sau khi trải qua một thí nghiệm bí mật của chính phủ, đặc vụ Tara của CIA có được khả năng biến hình thành bất kỳ ai thông qua quá trình biến đổi DNA, khiến cô trở thành kẻ xâm nhập tối thượng. Khi cha cô bị sát hại và bằng chứng chỉ ra cơ quan của chính cô, cô buộc phải trở thành kẻ lừa đảo. Bây giờ, cô phải ngăn chặn uranium bị đánh cắp gây ra thảm họa hạt nhân toàn cầu.

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: NA TRA: ĐƯỜNG ĐUA RỰC LỬA - NEZHA
programme.desc: Một cựu tay đua hàng đầu muốn chứng tỏ bản thân trong một cuộc đua nhưng lại vô tình làm tổn thương đồng đội Lily, dẫn đến sự sụp đổ của đội. Khi một nhà vô địch đua xe ảo thiếu kinh nghiệm gia nhập đội và bất ngờ tỏa sáng trong một cuộc đua ngoài đời thực, liệu ba tay đua có thể hợp tác để giành lại vinh quang cho đội của mình?

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: CHIẾN BINH THỰC TẾ ẢO - VR FIGHTER
programme.desc: Vệ sĩ Long Wei mắc chứng rối loạn căng thẳng sau chấn thương tâm lý sau cái chết của vợ. Một ngày nọ, anh gặp Amy, người đang làm việc cho một công ty công nghệ VR và được mời dùng thử sản phẩm mới. Sau cuộc thử nghiệm, Long Wei trở thành chiến binh VR của công ty và mặc bộ áo giáp mới được phát minh. Tuy nhiên, khi những người đàn ông có vũ trang bí ẩn đột nhập, một trận chiến khốc liệt vừa mới bắt đầu...

programme.title: VÕ TÒNG BÁO THÙ - WUSONG VS XIMENQING
programme.desc: Ngô Song phát hiện ra chuyện chị dâu ngoại tình với một người đàn ông giàu có, Tây Môn Khánh. Qing gài bẫy Song và đày anh ta trong một năm, trong thời gian đó người anh trai kém may mắn của anh ta bị sát hại và hỏa táng. Cuối cùng, khi Song trở về nhà, anh đưa vụ án ra tòa nhưng thẩm phán gạt nó sang một bên và đột ngột đóng lại. Liệu Song cuối cùng có thể trả thù cho cái chết của anh trai mình?
